ai_summary: Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited successfully completed its intended share buyback of 1,44,639 equity shares for approximately INR 29 crore, reducing its outstanding shares by 2.38%. A key material impact is the resultant increase in the Promoter & Promoter Group's shareholding from 48.98% to 50.17%, enhancing their control. While the buyback was significantly oversubscribed by 2.31 times, the provided post-buyback shareholding pattern table for non-promoter categories contains apparent aggregation/formatting errors, which hinders a complete and clear understanding of other ownership shifts.
